Definition: feminine of G4742; a point of time, i.e. an instant:--moment.
BiblicalUsage: A moment is all the devil needed. Taking Jesus up into an high mountain, he shewed unto Him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time. Every kingdom, in one instant, offered for a bow.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the moment shows the devil's bargain in full: all the world, at once, for one act of worship.
